name: 14895 · Wellsville, NY
findings: ZIP 14895 (Wellsville) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14895 (Wellsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14895 (Wellsville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
